html:
Prompt Caching

Reusing eligible processing of repeated input prefixes to reduce repeated work.

In practice

Keep stable project rules and tool definitions before changing user input. Matching, minimum length and expiry depend on the provider.

What to check

Inspect actual cache-usage fields and compare cost and time to first output. Configuration alone does not prove a hit.

Common confusion

This does not cache entire answers or create durable memory. Pricing, eligibility and invalidation vary by provider.
